assumptions.aspect_ratio_wing.source: XV-15 class; free trade in plan 029
assumptions.aspect_ratio_wing.label: Wing aspect ratio
assumptions.aspect_ratio_wing.note: One-sided: rotor clearance and engine-out power bind, so the derivative holds for an increase only. Flutter-limited: with whirl flutter in the loop the optimum is AR 7.0-7.2 (plan 055).

assumptions.thickness_to_chord_wing.label: Wing thickness ratio
assumptions.thickness_to_chord_wing.note: Flutter-limited: thinner raises L/D but lowers the flutter speed (plan 046: 18 % flutters at 230 kt); with flutter in the loop the optimum is 27-28 % (plan 055).

factors.wing_tiltrotor.label: Wing weight factor

assumptions.frequency_coning_per_rev.label: Rotor coning frequency
assumptions.frequency_coning_per_rev.note: AFDD-82 rotor weight goes as the flap frequency to the power 2.17, and the rotor factor (0.69) was fitted at the XV-15's 1.55/rev: a hub-stiffness lever only once the Halo hub is defined, tied to the calibration until then
